verdicts.reason: A shrinks the wind turbine, the key image, to a tiny icon jammed into a strip at the bottom edge. The red and blue shapes and the short lines are piled into that same strip, a long diagonal line cuts across the left side, and the green shape floats just above the headline, so the original's icon-over-headline arrangement is gone. B keeps the turbine stacked over the headline as one group, but that group is pressed against the top and bottom edges. Its green and blue corner triangles have been turned into odd floating shapes in the middle of the right half, and the line accents are scattered at random, so the right side looks arbitrary and the balance is lopsided.
